Subject: Mid-cycle seat increase — split billing between BridgePort US & EU

Hi Alex,

We increased our seat count mid-cycle (effective Nov 5) and need the prorated charges split between our US and EU entities. Can Redwood issue two invoices: one billed to BridgePort, Inc. (US) and one billed to BridgePort BV (EU) with reverse-charge VAT handling?

Details you might need:
- Plan before: 20 seats total
- Change on 2026-11-05: +4 seats (total 24) — we'd like 14 seats billed to BridgePort, Inc. (US) and 10 seats billed to BridgePort BV (EU) for the remainder of the month.
- EU VAT ID: pending (we can provide if needed)
- Preferred payment: single wire referencing both invoice numbers, or separate wires if Redwood prefers.

Please advise next steps and whether you need a PO or signed MOP update. We need the invoices by COB Nov 13 to get this processed in our month-end.

Thanks,
Sasha Cole
Head of Procurement
BridgePort Analytics

Attachments: change_request_20261105.pdf (pdf)

Hi Sasha,

Thanks — we can do that. A few quick clarifying items so Finance can reissue correctly:
1) Confirm effective date as 2026-11-05 (you listed it; just making it explicit).
2) Confirm the split: 14 seats to BridgePort, Inc. (US) and 10 seats to BridgePort BV (EU) for 11/05–11/30 prorations.
3) Please provide the EU VAT ID and the billing contact for BridgePort BV (name/email).
4) Payment method: single wire referencing both invoice numbers is fine — Finance will accept a single remittance if both invoice IDs are listed.

I'll loop in Finance (Vivek) to confirm VAT handling and to prepare the two prorated invoices and an internal note explaining the apportionment. Priyom, can you attach the stub calculation you use so we can confirm the exact dollar splits?

I should be able to get revised invoice PDFs to you by EOD Nov 12 if we have the VAT ID. If you can't provide it in time, we'll issue the US invoice and hold the EU invoice pending VAT documentation (we can issue a credit/adjustment after).

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive — Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Thanks — I reviewed the stub. Finance notes and action items:

1) VAT / Tax treatment:
- For BridgePort BV (EU): we require a valid EU VAT ID on file to apply reverse-charge. If VAT ID is provided and validates, we'll issue the EU invoice net of VAT with the note: "Reverse charge — VAT to be accounted for by the customer under Article 196 (or local equivalent)."
- If VAT ID is not provided before invoice issuance, we'll issue a provisional invoice including VAT; we can reissue a corrected credit note when proof is supplied.

2) Invoice language and line items:
- Use explicit apportionment description: "Apportioned mid-cycle charge — Seats allocated 11/05–11/30 (26 days). Unit price $X per seat/month — prorated for 26/30 days."
- Include PO #BP-98741 on both invoices.

3) Payment & collection:
- Single remittance is acceptable if the wire references both invoice numbers. Our AP team will reconcile against both invoice IDs.
- If BridgePort requests separate legal-entity remittances, we will accept separate wires to the respective entity's bank account.

4) Timing:
- If we get VAT ID by EOD Nov 11 we will issue both finalized invoices by EOD Nov 12. Otherwise, US invoice will go out and EU will be held or issued provisionally and corrected once VAT ID is received.

I've attached a short note (sample_tax_note.txt) with the suggested EU invoice tax text. Please let me know if you want Finance to add a small courtesy credit for the administrative overhead — we can approve on a case-by-case basis; flag for Marissa if you think this is necessary to close the renewal.

Vivek
VP, Finance — Redwood Inference

Attachments: sample_tax_note.txt
